title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct numerical ratio of pV/RT at the critical point.

title: Critical Point Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies and applies the conditions for the critical point involving the first and second derivatives of pressure with respect to volume.

title: Equation of State Application
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly uses Dieterici's equation to derive necessary relationships for the critical point.

title: Intermediate Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student shows clear intermediate steps leading to the determination of V and RT at the critical point.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks and confirms the consistency of units throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to correctly apply the conditions for the critical point, leading to an incorrect value for V or RT.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes sign mistakes in the derivatives or in the application of the equation of state.
